description: This Java class, ExceptionFactory, provides static methods to create various specific DittoRuntimeException instances related to features, attributes, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and other errors in a persistence context for Eclipse Ditto's thing management. It acts as a factory encapsulating exception creation logic for command strategies.

classes.name: ExceptionFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing static methods for creating various types of DittoRuntimeException related to attributes, features, ACLs, and access issues within a command strategy context.

methods.name: attributesNotFound
methods.description: Creates an AttributesNotAccessibleException indicating attributes could not be found for the given ThingId.

methods.name: attributeNotFound
methods.description: Creates an AttributeNotAccessibleException for a specific attribute key on a given ThingId.

methods.name: featureNotFound
methods.description: Creates a FeatureNotAccessibleException indicating a feature could not be found for the given ThingId.

methods.name: featuresNotFound
methods.description: Creates a FeaturesNotAccessibleException indicating multiple features could not be found for the given ThingId.

methods.name: aclInvalid
methods.description: Creates an AclModificationInvalidException to indicate an invalid ACL modification, optionally including a message.

methods.name: aclEntryNotFound
methods.description: Creates an AclNotAccessibleException indicating an ACL entry for a specific authorization subject could not be found.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotFound
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinitionNotAccessibleException indicating a feature definition could not be found.

methods.name: featurePropertyNotFound
methods.description: Creates a FeaturePropertyNotAccessibleException indicating a specific feature property could not be found.

methods.name: featurePropertiesNotFound
methods.description: Creates a FeaturePropertiesNotAccessibleException indicating properties of a feature could not be found.
